title: evolve gc reaps no cycle worktree: every sealed cycle's run.json keeps active_worktree, so gc reads it as live
summary: 2026-09-29 storage cleanup: .evolve/worktrees held 87 cycle worktrees (7.3 GB) and `evolve gc --dry-run` planned 0 removals and flagged none. WorktreeOptions.isLive treats a worktree as live when any .evolve/runs/*/run.json names it as active_worktree, and a sealed cycle's run.json keeps that pointer forever (cycles 1601, 1700, 1740 checked), so every preserved worktree is excluded before the dirty/unmerged/merged rules run. The operator reclaimed 6.7 GB with `evolve worktree cleanup -cycle N` per cycle after saving dirty state to backups by hand.
fix: A run is live only while it is unsealed and its lease/pid is alive (or the cycle-state names it as the active cycle); a sealed run's active_worktree never protects its worktree. Then the existing rules apply: merged+clean+dead → remove; dirty/unmerged → flag. Consider an operator path for sealed, unmerged, unbound worktrees older than N days that saves the uncommitted state (patch + untracked archive) before removal, and never touches a continuation-bound worktree.
acceptance: A sealed cycle's worktree with a stale run.json active_worktree is not live (red today)
A continuation-bound worktree is never reaped
`evolve gc --dry-run` on a plane with old sealed cycles plans or flags each of them
